image_description: A group of adults standing in a circle inside a gymnasium or community hall with wooden floors. In the center is a tall, thin pole (maypole) decorated with colorful ribbons/streamers extending from the top. The people appear to be holding the streamers or preparing to dance around the pole. There are some objects on the floor in the foreground that look like sports equipment or markers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There are two strange, wire-frame-like structures on the floor in the bottom left and center. They do not resemble standard gym equipment or maypole bases. They look like AI-hallucinated objects with nonsensical geometry (floating triangles, unclear connectivity).

Where the participants' hands meet the ribbons, there is significant blurring and fusion. It is difficult to distinguish individual fingers gripping the fabric; the hands seem to melt into the streamers.
Faces have a slightly waxy, uniform texture typical of AI generation. Clothing folds lack sharp definition in some areas, appearing slightly smudged.
The lines of the windows and walls in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective, particularly on the left side.
